Frequently asked questions about sweeteners, syrups & starches

What are sweeteners, syrups & starches used for?

Sweeteners, Syrups & Starches can support texture, stability, flavour, processing and production consistency across relevant finished-food applications. The exact function depends on the selected product and grade.

Which sweeteners, syrups & starches does Vikranth supply?

This page lists Liquid Glucose, Sorbitol 70% Solution, Invert Sugar, Sorbitol, Aspartame, Maize Starch, Potato Starch, Dextrose Monohydrate, Maltodextrin Powder, Corn Syrup. Current grade, pack size, stock and manufacturer availability are confirmed for each enquiry.

Can I buy sweeteners, syrups & starches in bulk in Chennai?

Vikranth accepts B2B enquiries in Chennai. Share the product, grade, quantity, delivery area and timeline so current supply details can be checked.

Can sweeteners, syrups & starches be supplied across India?

Pan-India business enquiries are welcome. Delivery coverage, freight, lead time and minimum quantity depend on the product and destination and are confirmed before quotation.

Can I request product specifications, COA or a sample?

Yes. State the product, application and trial quantity. Specific documents and samples remain subject to product and manufacturer availability.

Which ingredient is suitable for my application?

Share the finished product, process, target performance, required grade, expected quantity and timeline so relevant available options can be reviewed and trialled.
